title: C language adapter
description:
Add C language support via tree-sitter-c. See docs/adding-languages.md for the full sketch.

Key work:
- Parser: functions, structs, enums, typedefs, macros, global variables
- Import resolution: #include directives — resolve relative and project-root-relative, system includes as unresolved external edges
- Complexity: add "c" branches to classify_cognitive
- FCA attributes: returns_ptr, takes_ptr, is_static, is_inline, is_variadic, has_const, returns_void
- Effect patterns: heap (malloc/free), fs (fopen/fwrite), net (socket/connect), io (printf)
- Flags: test file heuristics, __attribute__ for FFI
- Module boundary strength: Weak

Estimated effort: ~5 days. Validates the adapter interface on a third language.

Risks: header file indexing strategy (index .h as peers or .c only?), preprocessor conditionals invisible to tree-sitter, forward declaration deduplication.

acceptance_criteria.text: CAdapter implements LanguageAdapter with language_id "c", extensions ["c", "h"]
Parser extracts functions, structs, enums, typedefs, function-like macros (Macro), value macros (Const with header-guard filtering), and global variables
Signatures extracted for functions: return_type name(params)
Docstrings extracted from preceding block/line comments
References classified: call_expression→Call, field_expression→FieldAccess, type_identifier in param/return→TypeUse, struct initializer→Construction
#include directives produce ExtractedImport with raw_path preserving quotes/angles
resolve_c_imports resolves quoted includes (relative + project-root-relative) and compile_commands.json -I paths; angle-bracket includes stored as unresolved external edges
compile_commands.json parsed for -I/-isystem paths when present
classify_cognitive and walk_cyclomatic have "c" branches covering if/for/while/do/switch/case/goto and logical operators
FcaAttributeSource implemented with returns_ptr, takes_ptr, is_static, is_inline, is_variadic, has_const, returns_void, has_struct_param
C_EFFECT_PATTERNS covers heap (malloc/free), fs (fopen/fwrite), net (socket/connect), io (printf/puts)
Test file heuristics: *_test.c, test_*.c, tests/*.c; function test_* in test files flagged
__attribute__ entries flagged as FFI entry points
Smoke parse test, symbol extraction test, reference classification test, import edge test, and complexity test for C adapter

decisions.rationale: C's public API lives almost entirely in headers — structs, enums, typedefs, macros. Indexing .c only would make most of a project's API invisible to sutra.
decisions.rejected_alternative: .c only — avoids forward declaration duplicates but loses all header-only symbols

decisions.decision: Accept forward declaration duplicates, let resolver handle via confidence scoring
decisions.rationale: Least invasive approach; existing resolver already handles same-name symbols across files. Forward declarations naturally lack bodies, giving downstream tools enough signal to deprioritize them.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Dedup at DB insert time — would require a new post-insert pass in post_parse_sequence

decisions.decision: Store all #include directives as imports including system headers
decisions.rationale: Consistency with Rust's treatment of std:: imports. System includes become unresolved external edges, available to constraint checking.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Filter system includes at parse time — less DB noise but loses dependency information

decisions.decision: Filter header guard #defines at parse time
decisions.rationale: Header guards (_H, _H_, _INCLUDED suffixes) are noise in symbol tables. Value and function-like macros are worth indexing for sutra_grep discovery.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Index all #defines — simple but pollutes symbol tables with meaningless guards

decisions.decision: Include compile_commands.json support in initial implementation
decisions.rationale: Determines how many include paths resolve successfully. The format is simple JSON; parsing -I/-isystem flags from the command field is straightforward.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Defer to follow-up — simpler initial scope but many includes would stay unresolved

execution_record: Implemented across sessions 1-3 (sutra/182, 183, 184). Parser, adapter, import resolver, complexity branches, effect patterns, and pipeline wiring landed in commits 79610e7 through 16c30f2. Real-world validation: swisseph (78 files, 2461 symbols, 99 import edges resolved). Linux kernel parse in progress as stress test. No significant surprises — the implementation plan held. Header guard filtering and compile_commands.json support worked as designed. The only structural decision not in the original plan was per-TU include path scoping (68df395), which was a follow-up refinement to the import resolver.
